_comment: Seed 废案 files that no longer ship (ADR 0053: 废案_08–12 were consolidated into two longer conversations, so 10/11/12 have no successor file). materializeSeedFeian only ever WRITES, so without this an existing workspace would keep the retired files alongside the consolidated ones and Herta would read both.
